Senior Software Engineer

+91-9807654976  shubhamchaurasia84@yahoo.com

  https://www.linkedin.com/in/shubhamchaurasia84  Bangalore ,Karnataka

Summary

8 Years of IT - Experience as a Backend Java Developer for different Implementations Projects. Including one year of onsite exposure , Developed banking solutions and worked on CCAR regulatory reporting for the banking sector.

Technical Summary :

Experience in working in environments using Agile (SCRUM) and waterfall development methodologies.

Hands on experience on Design and Development Using Tech Skills like Java8+, Microservices and Monolithic Architecture, Spring 3.x.x, Hibernate/JPA ,SpringBoot , Restfull API ,Maven,Html,Css, Javascripts, Basic Angular ,Fabrik ,Unix ,OCP4 and Helm Charts.

Worked on Databases like Oracle SQL Developer, IBM DB2 and Postgres.

Experience on configuring and deploying Web/Enterprise Java Applications using Tomcat, Web sphere, Web logic and JBoss Application servers.

Expertise in developing Web applications using Java, J2EE, Spring (Spring IOC, Spring MVC), RESTful Web services.

Have worked in EJB + JPA + Restful embedded framework.

Have worked in Microservice Architecture (SAGA choreography pattern).

Experience in understanding of the DevOps process with continuous integration using TeamCity, Jenkins, JIRA, GIT and SVN.

Experience in Shell scripting using curl bash cron grep sed commands.

Have Done SpringBoot and JDK Upgrade from Spring2.7.8/jdk11 to Spring 3.4.0 with jdk17 .

Good experience in Unit Testing in developing test cases with Junit/PowerMockito for Unit testing and logging using Log4j.

Modified existing Swagger for the services for Documenting Rest API.

Domain knowledge and business expertise in Core Banking Solution ,Legal and Taxes and Reporting Domain.

Involved into SIT , UAT and PROD support to resolve the PROD issues.

Have done small POC on Angular and JavaScript.

Detail oriented analysis over requirements to arrive at the best possible solution.

Expertise in Problem Solving, Bug Fixing and Impact analysis with team by helping them whenever needed .

sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
Summary
8 Years of IT - Experience as a Backend Java Developer for different Implementations Projects. Including one year of onsite exposure , Developed banking solutions and worked on CCAR regulatory reporting for the banking sector.
Technical Summary :
Experience in working in environments using Agile (SCRUM) and waterfall development methodologies.
Hands on experience on Design and Development Using Tech Skills like Java8+, Microservices and Monolithic Architecture, Spring 3.x.x, Hibernate/JPA ,SpringBoot , Restfull API ,Maven,Html,Css, Javascripts, Basic Angular ,Fabrik ,Unix ,OCP4 and Helm Charts.
Hand on experience in PL-SQL (cursor+trigger+function).
Hands on experience in Spring core, DAO, Web MVC, AOP, Hibernate.
Worked on Databases like Oracle SQL Developer, IBM DB2 and Postgres.
Experience on configuring and deploying Web/Enterprise Java Applications using Tomcat, Web sphere, Web logic and JBoss Application servers.
Expertise in developing Web applications using Java, J2EE, Spring (Spring IOC, Spring MVC), RESTful Web services.
Have worked in EJB + JPA + Restful embedded framework.
Have worked in Microservice Architecture (SAGA choreography pattern).
Experience in understanding of the DevOps process with continuous integration using TeamCity, Jenkins, JIRA, GIT and SVN.
Experience in Shell scripting using curl bash cron grep sed commands.
Have Done SpringBoot and JDK Upgrade from Spring2.7.8/jdk11 to Spring 3.4.0 with jdk17 .
Good experience in Unit Testing in developing test cases with Junit/PowerMockito for Unit testing and logging using Log4j.
Modified existing Swagger for the services for Documenting Rest API.
Domain knowledge and business expertise in Core Banking Solution ,Legal and Taxes and Reporting Domain.
Involved into SIT , UAT and PROD support to resolve the PROD issues.
Have done small POC on Angular and JavaScript.
Detail oriented analysis over requirements to arrive at the best possible solution.
Expertise in Problem Solving, Bug Fixing and Impact analysis with team by helping them whenever needed .
